title: Signal
description: One observation of the House's agents: an event, a metric, a span or a reference to an evaluation, content-free by default. DESIGN.md defines each field; scripts/check_signals.py checks a signal against this schema and the rules in DESIGN.md that a schema can't state, such as the attribute registry in conventions.json.

contract.description: The contract version, MAJOR.MINOR. A reader reads any minor of its own major.

name.description: From conventions.json's names for the kind. A span's name may add one target after a space, such as its model.

tenant.description: The opaque tenant the signal belongs to. Nothing joins across tenants.

producer.description: What emitted it, as <hive>/<component>, or a backend adapter's name.

adapter.description: The adapter that translated it, when it didn't come from the producer directly.

conventions.description: The semantic convention releases its names follow. A record from before GenAI left the core conventions has only core.

observedAt.description: Event time: when it happened, by the producer's clock.

ingestedAt.description: When a sink or reader received it, by its own clock.

basis.description: measured when the producer or provider counted it, estimated when it was computed, unknown when nobody knows.

correlation.description: Opaque IDs that join the signal to its owners' records. Every one is optional; an absent one is unattributed, never guessed.

passportSha256.description: The passport's digest, as the audit log's agent.sha256.

runId.description: A workflows-hive run, as the run record's and the ledger's runId.

turn.description: A model turn of the run.

taskId.description: An A2A task, as the ledger's taskId.

client.description: The calling client app's ID, as the ledger's client. An app, never a person.

call.description: The digest of a step's exact call, as the audit log's call.

approval.description: An approval ID, as the run record's pending.id and the review queue's item.

outcome.description: A results.jsonl id recording the outcome the work produced.

change.description: The commit the producer ran on.

deployment.description: The deployment or revision it ran in.

trace.description: W3C Trace Context IDs. A correlation handle, never an identity or a permission.

sampling.description: The share of such signals kept. null when unknown; absent when nothing was sampled out.

attributes.description: Only names in conventions.json; a metric's only of class label. Scalars only.

capture.description: A policy-controlled exception that lets named content attributes through. Absent by default.

policy.description: Where the product's policy that allows it lives.

value.description: A metric's value. null is unknown, never zero.

unit.description: A UCUM unit, as conventions.json gives for the metric.

outcome.description: An evaluation's outcome, as results.jsonl's, or unknown.

migratedFrom.description: Set by a reader that migrated an older record: the conventions it was written under.

time.description: ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, with Z.

opaque.description: An opaque ID: no spaces, no @, nothing that reads as a name or an address.
